sources.title: San Francisco — Jeanette MacDonald, YouTube film excerpt

sources.researchNote: The upload contains edited film footage with introductory credit text. The description explicitly says “Restored and sweetened soundtrack”; it is therefore not presented as an untouched copy of the original film soundtrack or a separately identified commercial recording. The title and description identify Jeanette MacDonald and San Francisco (1936). The structured date is YouTube publication.

media.title: San Francisco — video reference
media.description: Edited viewing reference for “San Francisco”, attributed by the uploader to Jeanette MacDonald in the MGM film San Francisco (1936). The upload contains film footage and describes its soundtrack as restored and sweetened.

contributions.scopeNote: Introduced the title song in San Francisco (MGM, 1936). AFI lists her second in the cast and its synopsis has her character sing “San Francisco” at the Chickens Ball, immediately before the earthquake sequence. This documents performance, not authorship of the work.
